categories.name: Merged Discharge
categories.description: Represents the discharge pathway mapped to alternative 17, advancing the goal of reaching a captured discharge while helping avoid post-discharge deterioration as measured by post-discharge ER return indicators.
categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping for alternative 17 (Merged 17+18), supported by variants such as V0551 and V0625 ending in Release A or Return ER which trace to this element.

categories.rationale: Default 1:1 mapping for alternative 19 (Release C), supported directly by variant V0710 ending in Release C.
